text.p: Britain's Rentokil Initial Plc said on Thursday that it had disposed of seven small businesses and made five acquisitions.
The total consideration for the disposals was 12 million stg while the acquisitions will cost 2.7 million in cash, it said in a statement.

Rentokil said the seven small businesses, which included Eddison Lift Truck services, Medical Services Incineration Ltd and a 50 percent stake in a cleaning partnership in New York and a scaffolding joint venture in Canada, had a combined turnover of 37 million stg.
Collectively, the operations made only a marginal profit contribution, the company said.
Rentokil's acquisitions have a total turnover of 4.8 million stg and add to its businesses in the U.S., South Africa and France.

They included the Merchants Detective Agency and Security Services in Detroit and an extension of a tropical plants business in South Africa into Cape Town with the acquisition of Berco Indoor Gardens.

"We have acquired bolt-on businesses to increase the density and profitability of our existing operations, and the disposals are part of our strategy to dispose of some businesses following the acquisition of BET last year." said Sir Clive Thompson, Rentokil Initial's chief executive.
